title: Accept what the Beloved sends
summary: Whatever the Friend does is received as intimate care, not as a case to dispute. Let acceptance begin with trust in the One who already knows the heart.
takeaway: Receive the Friend's doing before the complaint becomes your refuge.
lifeApplication: When the next sigh rises, unclench the jaw and say what is true: this too has arrived under the Beloved's eye. Let one protest become trust.

source.shortMeaning: The Friend's actions are received as pleasing because the heart has learned who is doing them.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next sigh, unclench the jaw and receive this moment from the Beloved rather than from fear.

evidence.coreClaim: The Friend's actions are received as pleasing because the heart has learned who is doing them.
evidence.turn: Acceptance becomes possible when the moment is seen as the Friend's doing, not an enemy's intrusion.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the next sigh rises, unclench the jaw and say what is true: this too has arrived under the Beloved's eye. Let one protest become trust.
